import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path('/home/brittonr/git/aspen-worktrees/guided-goal-completion-20261015')
evidence = repo / 'evidence/cairn-source-remediation-2026-10-15/attempt-16-current-run-shutdown-observation'
producer = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(strict=True)
environment = os.environ.copy()
environment['PATH'] = str(producer / 'bin') + os.pathsep + environment['PATH']
workspace = 'target/octet-f14-cohort16-workspace'
library = 'target/octet-f14-cohort16-library'
ledger = 'target/octet-f14-cohort16-ledger'


def run(name, argv):
    destination = evidence / (name + '.json')
    if destination.exists():
        raise RuntimeError(f'Preserving existing execution record: {destination}')
    recorded = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).with_name('record-command.py')),
                              str(destination), *argv], cwd=repo, env=environment,
                              capture_output=True, text=True)
    if not destination.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError(f'Command recorder failed: {recorded.stderr}')
    record = json.loads(destination.read_text())
    print(json.dumps({'record': destination.name, 'exit_code': record['exit_code'],
                      'elapsed_seconds': record['elapsed_seconds']}), flush=True)
    if record['exit_code'] != 0 or record['timed_out']:
        print(record['stdout'][-10000:], flush=True)
        print(record['stderr'][-16000:], file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(record['exit_code'] or 1)
    return record


# Continue after the already executed, passing source gate; do not repeat producers or mutate their evidence.
corpus = workspace + '/object-corpus-receipt.json'
cli = ['cargo', 'run', '--offline', '--locked', '--', 'test', 'octet']
gate = json.loads((evidence / 'ordered-strict-ci-gate.json').read_text())
if gate['exit_code'] != 0 or gate['timed_out'] or '<decision "pass">' not in (evidence / 'ordered-strict-ci-gate.preserves').read_text():
    raise RuntimeError('Recorded canonical strict source gate is not passing')
run('ordered-remediation-plan', [*cli, 'remediation', 'plan', '--artifacts', workspace,
    '--lib-artifacts', library, '--focused-object-corpus', corpus,
    '--receipt-out', str(evidence / 'ordered-remediation-plan.preserves')])

run('ordered-workspace-all-targets', ['cargo', 'test', '--offline', '--locked', '--workspace', '--all-targets'])
run('ordered-workspace-doctests', ['cargo', 'test', '--offline', '--locked', '--workspace', '--doc'])
features = 'doltlite-oracle,executable-extents,profiler-perf,profiler-alloc,world-snapshot-vm-cohort'
run('ordered-enabled-feature-tests', ['cargo', 'test', '--offline', '--locked', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--features', features])
run('ordered-disabled-profiler-tests', ['cargo', 'test', '--offline', '--locked', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--features', 'profiler-disabled'])
for name, selectors in [('default', []), ('enabled', ['--features', features]), ('disabled', ['--features', 'profiler-disabled'])]:
    run('ordered-' + name + '-clippy', ['cargo', 'clippy', '--offline', '--locked', '--workspace', '--all-targets', *selectors, '--', '-D', 'warnings'])
run('ordered-format-check', ['cargo', 'fmt', '--all', '--check'])
run('ordered-relevant-nix-checks', ['nix', 'build', '--no-update-lock-file', '--no-link', '-L',
    '.#checks.x86_64-linux.node-state-authority', '.#checks.x86_64-linux.nextest'])
run('ordered-strict-cairn-validation', ['/tmp/molten-attempts-6-7-l6bgn98w/cairn-provider/bin/cairn',
    'validate', '--root', '.', '--policy', '/home/brittonr/git/OnixResearch/cairn/cairn-policy/generated/cairn-policy.json', '--strict'])
